import sys,os,subprocess,time,tempfile,json,struct,signal,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/hoff/swdev/magic_and_mayhem_mod'); BASE=ROOT/'working/native-render-profile-20261007'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'protocols/python'))
from mnm_protocols import frame_v1,render_commands_v2

def stop(p):
 if p and p.poll() is None:
  os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  try:p.wait(timeout=5)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait()

run=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='live-',dir=BASE));print(run,flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('MNM_')}
env.update(QT_QPA_PLATFORM='xcb',LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE='1',WINEDEBUG='-all',WINEPREFIX=str(run/'wineprefix'))
subprocess.run(['cp','-a','--reflink=auto',str(ROOT/'working/wineprefix-x86_64'),env['WINEPREFIX']],check=True)
with (run/'wineboot.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(['wineboot','-u'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=log,timeout=120,check=True)
for ordered in [0,1]:
 case=run/('ordered' if ordered else 'default');case.mkdir(); print(case,flush=True)
 frame=case/'frame.bin';channel=case/'commands.bin'
 for path,header,size in [(frame,frame_v1.initial_header(),frame_v1.SIZE),(channel,render_commands_v2.initial_header(),render_commands_v2.SIZE)]:
  b=bytearray(header)
  if path==channel:struct.pack_into('<I',b,16,1)
  with path.open('wb') as out:out.write(b);out.truncate(size)
 e=dict(env,MNM_RENDER_CONTINUOUS='1',MNM_RENDER_SESSION_ARCHIVE='1',MNM_RENDER_ORDERED_COPIES=str(ordered))
 stage=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/'tools/run-opengl-game.py'),'--stream',str(frame),'--command-channel',str(channel),'--skip-movies','--stage-only'],env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 (case/'stage.log').write_text(stage.stdout+stage.stderr)
 exp=Path(next(l.split(': ',1)[1] for l in stage.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('Render experiment: ')))
 game=exp/'game'
 for key,path in [('MNM_RENDER_STREAM',frame),('MNM_RENDER_COMMAND_CHANNEL',channel),('MNM_RENDER_LOCK_CAPTURE_DIR',exp/'lock-capture'),('MNM_RENDER_FAILURE_LOG',exp/'surface-failures.log')]:e[key]='Z:'+str(path).replace('/','\\')
 e['MNM_RENDER_OWNED_SESSION']='1'
 meta=json.loads((exp/'manifest.json').read_text());qt=wine=None
 try:
  with (case/'qt.log').open('w') as qlog,(case/'wine.log').open('w') as wlog:
   qt=subprocess.Popen(['perf','record','-e','cpu-clock:u','-F','199','-g','--call-graph','dwarf,16384','-o',str(case/'perf.data'),'--',str(BASE/'build/native-profile'),str(channel),str(case/'timings.json'),'25'],env=e,stdout=qlog,stderr=qlog,start_new_session=True)
   deadline=time.monotonic()+15
   while not (case/'timings.json.ready').exists():
    if qt.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('Consumer not ready')
    time.sleep(.05)
   wine=subprocess.Popen(['wine','explorer','/desktop=NativeProfile,800x600',str(game/'Chaos.exe')],cwd=game,env=e,stdout=wlog,stderr=wlog,start_new_session=True)
   samples=[];start=time.monotonic()
   while time.monotonic()-start<28:
    b=channel.read_bytes()[:64];samples.append({'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'header':list(struct.unpack('<16I',b))})
    if qt.poll() is not None:break
    time.sleep(.1)
   (case/'channel-samples.json').write_text(json.dumps(samples,indent=2))
   if qt.poll() is None:qt.wait(timeout=10)
   subprocess.run(['import','-window','root',str(case/'screen.png')],env=e,timeout=10,check=False)
 finally:
  stop(qt);stop(wine)
  subprocess.run(['wineserver','-k'],env=e,timeout=10,check=False)
 (case/'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps({'experiment':str(exp),'manifest':meta,'environment':{k:v for k,v in e.items() if k.startswith('MNM_') or k in ['DISPLAY','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE']},'sources':{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in list((ROOT/'runtime/render').glob('*.[ch]'))+[ROOT/'renderer/blit.cpp',ROOT/'renderer/command_consumer.cpp',ROOT/'apps/qt-shell/live_command_renderer.cpp'] }},indent=2))
 subprocess.run(['perf','report','--stdio','-i',str(case/'perf.data'),'--no-children','--sort','comm,dso,symbol','--percent-limit','1'],stdout=(case/'perf-report.txt').open('w'),stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 print((case/'timings.json').read_text()[:300] if (case/'timings.json').exists() else 'No timings',flush=True)
print('Done',flush=True)

limitations: Startup/Main menu only; battle throughput and end-to-end input latency unmeasured.
Isolated CPU renderer timing is not a desktop GPU baseline; no paired hardware comparison.
Native consumer harness uses real adapter/viewport but does not run the whole shell session/recovery/input controller.
No producer CPU profile; graphics worker dominance describes the native consumer process only.
External CPU load and perf instrumentation are uncontrolled; two order settings are observations, not a causal benchmark.
Frame rate counts captured PRESENT callbacks rather than monitor refresh or independent pixel-equivalence checks.
Time-limited consumer destruction cancels the session; subsequent producer cancellation diagnostics are expected cleanup, not failures during the measured interval.
Source hashes are the current uncommitted workspace; historical evidence remains unchanged.

findings.source_observation: GlBlitter::update independently makes/restores the renderer context per UPDATE. A future batch-context optimization could reduce repeated context work but has not been implemented or separately benchmarked.
findings.recommended_first_step: Remove --software-rendering and inherited Mesa software/vendor overrides; use an authenticated desktop X11/XWayland display; verify glxinfo -B reports hardware renderer.
